## 2026 Instagram Engagement Playbook — Core Frameworks

### 4 Ranking Engines
1. Feed — connected reach, relationship strength, saves/shares per reach, 72hr window. Favors carousels (up to 20 slides). Non-follower reach: 5-15%.
2. Reels — discovery engine, SPR (sends per reach) is #1 signal (3-5x weight of likes), then watch time, VCR, replay rate. Non-follower reach: 70-95%. Optimal: 7-15s loops or up to 3min tutorials.
3. Stories — relationship deepening, zero discovery. Ranked by closeness, DM replies, sticker interactions. Non-follower reach: <5%.
4. Explore — interest-based indexing, first-hour velocity, save rate, NLP keyword matching. Non-follower reach: 80-90%.
5. Search — semantic engine indexing bio name field, captions, on-screen text, alt text, audio transcripts.

### Signal Hierarchy
- HIGH: SPR (DM shares) 3-5x likes weight. >2% = viral. Saves 3x likes.
- MID: Comment depth (threaded discussions), DM replies, sticker taps.
- LOW: Likes (passive, ~5% of recommendation weight in 2026).

### Key Metrics
- SPR: 0.5-1% baseline, 1-2% strong, >2% viral
- VCR: >50% = Reels tab push, >80% = virality
- Hashtags: HARD 5 LIMIT. 2 niche + 2 broad + 1 branded.

### Harmful Tactics
- Bought followers = 14-90 day Explore suppression
- Engagement pods = removed from recommendations
- Browser bots = feature block or permanent deactivation
- High-frequency posting = dilutes engagement

### 10 Principles
1. Optimize for Sends over Likes
2. 1-second retention funnel
3. Keyword-rich captions (SEO)
4. Rule of 5 hashtags (2-2-1)
5. Maintain recommendation eligibility
6. Threaded conversation loops (reply within 60 min)
7. Watch time optimization (7-15s loops)
8. Me-centric storytelling
9. Eliminate dead air (1.5-3s cuts)
10. A/B test via Trial Reels

### Reels Script: 0-3s hook, 3-7s relevance, 7-12s payoff, 12-45s substance, end with send-ask CTA
### Psychology: Curiosity gaps, loss aversion, identity/mirror effect, immediate utility
### 30-Day: D1-7 audit/SEO, D8-17 trial reels, D18-24 collabs, D25-30 DM funnels
